name: WinGet-PSADT-GUI-Tool
description: WinGet-PSADT-GUI-Tool is a Windows PowerShell WPF GUI that streamlines Win32 app packaging and Intune deployment. It integrates WinGet search, installer download, PSADT scaffolding, and GUI-driven configuration of install/uninstall/repair logic, enabling generation of .intunewin packages and direct upload to Intune via Microsoft Graph. It outputs standard PSADT/Intune artifacts and provides live monitoring of packaging and upload steps.
author: Dhiraj Dhote

securityCheck.aiSummary: No evidence in the provided code of remote script downloads, credential harvesting, data exfiltration, reverse shells, or hardcoded secrets. The only notable pattern is the usage of base64-encoded -EncodedCommand in a helper function, which could be abused to obfuscate actions. The rest of the code appears to implement standard Intune/PSADT tooling constructs (modular dot-sourcing, logging, UI helpers) with no obvious security violations.
